svg.title: Reception overview — proposed Grafana dashboard
svg.desc: Static Grafana-style concept mockup. All data is synthetic. No live queries, controls, or calibration actions.
svg.text: Observation only · proposed dashboard · no live connection
Collection current · 2,880 retained reports · 72 unique receiver labels · recent windows still subject to backfill
Reception by band and UTC hour
Received cycles, not attempted transmissions · cells show distinct reported UTC cycles
0 = no reports in a retrieved window
Distance distribution · reports, not independent paths
Stable example cohort · select one receiver for a path comparison
Illustrative receiver labels · locators describe approximate positions
No device identity is inferred from a callsign. This view does not measure decode probability or antenna gain.
Static design artifact · all values invented for layout review · filters and panels are nonfunctional
